concerns.text: FR-004 and SC-001 require evaluating a 'Baseline' model (no mid-training) alongside FIM and NL-Control. Tasks T023-T030 implement FIM and NL-Control training, but no task exists to generate or load the Baseline model required for the comparison in FR-004/SC-001.

FR-001 and SC-006 mandate that the system MUST fail the build if overlap > 0 between GSM8K and LogiQA. Task T018 implements the 'overlap check logic' but lacks a corresponding task to execute this check as a blocking gate (e.g., 'Run overlap validation and fail build if overlap detected') before dataset generation or training proceeds.

FR-005 and SC-002 require statistical significance testing against BOTH the NL-Control group AND the Baseline group. Tasks T034 and T035 describe generic 'compare groups' logic without explicitly mandating the inclusion of the Baseline in the t-test/Wilcoxon calculation, risking a partial implementation.

FR-001 requires verifying zero overlap between LogiQA and 'intermediate caches' of GSM8K examples. Task T018 only mentions checking 'GSM8K (train) and LogiQA (test) examples', omitting the specific validation against intermediate caching artifacts required by the spec.

Constitution Principle VII and Plan.md require 'format-based leakage verification' to ensure the pseudo-code structure does not encode test-set info. Phase 3 tasks (T014-T020) cover conversion and graph validation but lack a specific task to perform this format-based leakage check.

SC-005 requires measuring the 'rate of successful dependency graph construction' against a target. Task T020 implements a 'depth-distribution validator' with error code VAR-001 but misses the explicit task to calculate and report the success rate metric (successful_graphs / total_examples) required by SC-005.
